source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Use Ireasoning MIB browser professional:
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Open Ireasoning MIB browser, load the MIB files.
4. Setup the settings of MIB browser to access BMC according to the WEB UI SNMPv3 settings.
5. Left-click on the $target and expand subtree.
6. Right-Click on the node and use "Get Next" or "Get Subtree" to get all the values of the $target.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
Use NetSNMP to check.
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Put the mib files into the netsnmp search path.
http://www.net-snmp.org/docs/FAQ.html#Where_should_I_put_my_MIB_files_
4. Use NetSNMP "get type" of command(s) to retrieve the values of the $target from BMC.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: snmpwalk (net-snmp), BMC SNMP agent must be enabled + community configured
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- SNMP "monitor_temperature" monitoring reads specific BMC MIB data via the SNMP agent; from a 2nd management host run `snmpwalk -v2c -c ${SNMP_COMMUNITY:?operator must set SNMP community (v2c) or v3 creds} "$BMC_IP" .1.3.6.1.4.1.8072.2.3.2.1.2 | grep -i temperature (or walk the vendor MIB subtree once the SNMP community/v3 creds + MIB are configured). Enable + point SNMP agent first.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL snmpwalk output for the temperature OID subtree so the user confirms the monitor_temperature SNMP data is correct.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: SNMP queries need a management host + enabled/configured SNMP agent on the BMC (community/v3 + firewall); enabling SNMP is a config change, and some BMC SNMP sets expose credentials - use read-only community.

original_test_intent: Read platform temperature sensors through SNMPv3 and verify each sensor against state-specific warning/critical limits.
original_method: Engineer enables v3 and browses undefined `$target`; Criteria switch to Net-SNMP without defining temperature objects.
manual_activity: Engineer configures WebUI/SNMPv3; after target definition, automated polling and comparison can collect core telemetry.
safety_requirements: Read only and protect v3 secrets.
Stop/escalate on warning/critical temperature; do not continue stress blindly.
Preserve raw values/timestamps; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: After correction, sample exact sensors for the approved interval, decode units and compare thresholds/reference.
Do not configure WebUI or decide verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve sensor map/state/limits and configure/restore v3.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Wrong security mode and generic grep cannot prove sensor identity, units or thermal state.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use vendor MIB-resolved SNMPv3 temperature OIDs with full typed output and timestamps.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IReasoning, `$target`, Net-SNMP criterion and 10/5-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Query mapped inlet/component sensors in a defined load/ambient state, decode units and compare thresholds plus independent BMC telemetry.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor thermal sensor MIB and limits.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds sensor identity, state and time-series acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Telemetry cadence and placement affect comparison.

project_override_considerations: Project may choose an approved steady-state or stress window, but must record load, ambient, duration and sampled sensors.
expected_evidence: Raw typed time series and decoded temperatures

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure/Criteria change client while retaining undefined `$target`; DeepSeek changes security mode and invents a generic subtree.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Sensor map, state and limits are project inputs; manual SNMPv3 setup followed by automated telemetry is executable.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Corrects BLOCKED to PACKAGE under the locked missing-input rule.

review_improvement: Adds state-specific sensor mapping and safety-stop handling.
independent_technical_reasoning: Location/state determine meaning, but an approved map makes automated sampling valid. The engineer-configured WebUI is manual setup, so this is PARTIAL.
